group: addMatchReferences - Numeric Equal and Numeric Range

cases.description: Test that adding a match with NUMERIC_EQ type increments the hasNumeric counter.

Test that adding a match with NUMERIC_RANGE type increments the hasIP counter when isCIDR is true.

cases.expected: anythingButs should include match.getNextNameState() and hasNumeric should be unchanged.

group: addMatchReferences - Anything But Types with Numeric

cases.description: Test that adding a match with ANYTHING_BUT type that is numeric adds to anythingButs and increments hasNumeric.
